match.userMessage:
Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
EXT. DOWNTOWN ROOFTOP — SUNSET. Natural, even lighting. #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save, Clean and bright with true-to-life color. Whites are crisp, skin tones warm and natural. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base.

No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

Avoid jitter and bent limbs.

Shot 1 (0-3s): Image 2 closes her fingers around the lipstick instead of setting it down.. Make the color catch the last sun before her hand closes.. Camera: brief and smooth push-in

overall_soundscape: Wind softens beneath the distant train.

Shot 2 (3-6s): Image 2 takes Image 4’s hand and pulls her toward the stairwell as a train flashes behind them.. Carry their movement into the warm rooftop light.. Camera: accelerating, buoyant follow

overall_soundscape: Train rattles past; footsteps and wind.

Reference images:
Image 3: CORAL_LIPSTICK - A slim — keep visually consistent throughout the shot.

detailed_description:
The video is captured in a modern, social-first product photography style with tactile, editorial energy. The color palette is dominated by crisp whites, warm creams, and deep coral accents against neutral urban tones. The lighting is natural and even, with a slight warmth in the highlights and lifted shadows creating an airy atmosphere.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the scene begins with <Image 1>, a close-up of <Subject 2>'s hand holding <Subject 3> on a rooftop at sunset. Instead of setting it down, <Subject 2> slowly closes her fingers around the lipstick. The coral surface of the lipstick catches the final glint of the setting sun just before her hand covers it. The camera performs a brief, smooth push-in, emphasizing the matte texture of the metal tube and the creamy finish of the lipstick.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a wider angle where <Subject 2> reaches out and takes the hand of <Subject 4>, pulling her briskly toward a rooftop stairwell. In the background, a train flashes past, creating a blur of motion and light. They move together into the warm, golden rooftop light. The camera uses an accelerating, buoyant follow shot, capturing the energetic movement of both women as they exit the frame.

overall_soundscape:
The sound of wind softening beneath a distant train, followed by the heavy metallic rattle of a train passing by and the rhythmic thud of footsteps on concrete.
